preconditions.description: Attacker must be the contract owner (or gain owner privileges)

violation_target.exploit_hint: As the contract owner, call the blacklistAddress() function with any contract address and set value to true. This will prevent that contract from making any transactions (transfers, swaps, etc.) by causing the _transfer() function to revert with 'Blacklisted address' error. The exploit demonstrates unauthorized privilege escalation where the owner can arbitrarily stop any contract from interacting with the token.

attempts.vulnerability_analysis: The INCOME contract has a blacklistAddress() function that is only callable by the owner. This function can arbitrarily blacklist any address, preventing it from making transfers. This demonstrates unauthorized privilege escalation where the owner can disrupt any contract's interaction with the token.
attempts.attack_strategy: Impersonate the contract owner and call blacklistAddress() to blacklist a target address, then verify the blacklist status.
attempts.step_by_step_plan: 1. Find the current owner of the INCOME contract. 2. Use vm.prank() to impersonate the owner. 3. Call blacklistAddress() with a target address and value=true. 4. Verify that the address is now blacklisted.
